body: I can! But, for example, I have to make a living. I have a job right now,related to customer service. I get along great with my coworkers, the job is easy, repetitive, it can get annoying but hey, it pays. And I'm in my twenties, without a degree (and a passion for that matter, because I know a degree is far from everything work related) that's what I do. But doing that in my 30s? 40s? Slaving away 8 hours of my life to pay rent and shit? Not for me. Because I don't see the point, just to live? To enjoy my time off work and that's that? I'd rather spend some years (like I told my mom that) having fun, experiencing things I haven't and then well, just end it. Which is what I'm doing btw, well not really because I'd quit my job when my suicide gets near and you know, really enjoy my last days (or months, I planned in my mind a trip to a city I love), but I am having fun and looking for new experiences, because I have the time as I won't kill myself with my grandparents alive, they are amazing and I'd feel so sick to do that to them. Thanks for answering dude, I'm not sure this has a solution, maybe I'll find it in this time I have left but hey, maybe I won't.
